Next.js club management system for TJ Sokol Svinov (Czech handball club). Stack: Next.js 16 App Router · TypeScript strict · Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth) · TanStack Query v5 · HeroUI v2 · Tailwind CSS v4 · Vitest. UI language is **Czech** — all user-facing strings must be in Czech.

Available slash-command skills in `.claude/skills/` (use **without being asked** when the situation matches):  
`/new-entity` — whenever user asks to add a new database table, data model, or CRUD feature. Do not scaffold files manually; invoke this skill.  
`/db-sync` — after any DB migration is applied or when TypeScript types are out of sync with the database schema.  
`/new-migration` — whenever a new table, column, function, view, or RLS policy needs to be created in the database.  
`/generate-barrels` — after adding, renaming, or removing any hook, component, type, or enum file. Run before committing.  
`/review-pr` — when user asks for a code review / PR review / “check my changes”.
